tools.name: read_stock_count_sheet
tools.description: Reads a saved cycle-count sheet (CSV) for a warehouse zone and returns the rows with their SKU, bin, and counted quantity.

params.name: sheet_name
params.description: File name of the count sheet inside the count sheets folder

tools.name: get_supplier_packing_slip
tools.description: Loads a supplier packing slip stored as a JSON file and returns the PO number, supplier, and the list of line items received.

params.name: slip_file
params.description: Name of the packing slip JSON file in the receiving folder

tools.name: load_bin_location_map
tools.description: Reads a warehouse aisle layout file and returns the bin locations defined for the given aisle, one per line.

params.name: aisle_file
params.description: Name of the aisle layout text file in the layouts folder

params.name: max_bins
params.description: Maximum number of bin locations to return
